about_the_game:
"Peek might be one of the more nerve-wracking concepts I’ve seen in a while." – Rely on Horror

An audio-deduction horror game where the best way to play is to close your eyes.

**This game features immersive spatial audio, and listening closely is the core gameplay mechanic. Headphones/earbuds are STRONGLY recommended to survive.**

Peek is an audio-driven horror puzzle game where you must track a restless spirit by listening to the room around you. During tense ritual rounds, a spirit stalks the darkness while its location is revealed through the sounds of the environment. Close your eyes and listen carefully. Use audio clues to sense her direction, but rely on the environment to mentally map her exact path. Deduce where she leaves her clues, then open your eyes to place the correct relics and banish her!

You are Father Herman Goldie, summoned by the McFarland family to cleanse their den of its former occupant, the late Edna Maney, whose body was found under mysterious circumstances in the attic weeks ago. Though her remains have been removed, something else still lingers.

Every part of the room has its own sound.

THE RITUAL: Kneeling in the center of a 5x5 grid of blessed salts, you must engage in a terrifying exchange of "Horror Simon."

  • Listen: The room is a grid of sounds. As the spirit moves in the dark, she triggers each square's unique audio footprint: a squeaky floorboard, a blood-soaked rug, hanging windchimes, and more.

  • Pinpoint: Identify her pattern. Track her movements on the grid using only your ears, memorizing exactly where she leaves her ritual sounds.

  • Bind: Open your eyes and place the correct relics on the active tiles to exorcise the room of her presence.

  • Survive: If you make too many mistakes, the room may be your final resting place, as well!

And most importantly...

DON'T PEEK!

Close your eyes. Listen to the room. Remember where she walked.

Features:

  • True 3D Binaural Audio: Spatial sounds powered by Steam Audio with full HRTF support for immersion in the dark.

  • Escalating Dread: The spirit grows increasingly hostile, demanding an ever‑larger ritual with more complex relic combinations.

  • Custom Scenarios: Create your own rituals and determine the number of squares and relic types per round.

  • Endless mode: Challenge your attention and memory by increasing the number of ritual squares by one until your memory breaks!

  • Titles: Begin as an Acolyte and work your way up through the ranks, unlocking new modes in the process.

  • Game modes: Earn bizarre, rule-breaking alternate modes to test your sanity (and take the edge off a little).
